name: io.github.ivanoats/wsg-check
title: WSG Check
description: Check websites against the W3C Web Sustainability Guidelines and look up the guidelines

packageArguments.description: Runs the MCP server over stdio instead of a one-off check

environmentVariables.name: WSG_CHECK_NO_LOCAL
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to block localhost and other loopback URLs, which are allowed by default

environmentVariables.name: WSG_CHECK_ALLOW_PRIVATE
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to allow private network URLs (10/8, 172.16/12, 192.168/16)
